outcome: Every money-correctness property the system brief names for g1 is proven by a passing offline test: the LF-1 and LF-2 fixture reproductions, the five ledger invariants (journals balance, no orphan posting, reserved <= settled, no double pledge, unknown != zero), draw beyond K_p rejected, no duplicate movement, no movement from unowned funds, altered approval refused, timeout resolved by query, reconciliation closes the advance, clairvoyant policy rejected, credential isolation and the eight money-safety hunts. name: money_checks_pct
unit: percent of the 16 required g1 checks in checks/required.json whose registered pytest node ids all pass offline; a check with no registered tests, or whose ids do not exist, counts as failing
source: python3 checks/kpi.py g1 --print (T22: runs checks/goals/g1.py, which runs uv run pytest -q --junitxml var/kpi/g1.xml on the ids in checks/required.json group g1 and prints the passing share in %; prints the baseline with the reason on stderr when it cannot run). Defined in prp/2026-10-20-ledgerworld/00-system.md section 17, row g1 (KPI money_checks_pct, target 100).
observation: At the commit under test, run python3 checks/kpi.py g1 --print and read the printed percent. Until checks/kpi.py exists, observe by hand: for each of the 16 entries in checks/required.json group g1, the check passes only if its tests list is non-empty and uv run pytest -q <those ids> exits 0; the value is 100 * passing / 16. An empty tests list, a missing node id or any failing test counts that check as failing. Observe after every landing train and before the build freeze (2026-11-12) and submission close (2026-11-13 18:29 UTC). Met when the value is 100.
